root_cause: The Netlify site is currently deployed through an API source upload rather than GitHub auto-build. A main merge therefore does not by itself create a new Netlify Functions build. The existing Production Source Snapshot workflow can create an exact-main source artifact on a GitHub-hosted runner.
prevention_rule: For API-sourced Netlify production recovery, create an exact-main source artifact through the canonical Production Source Snapshot workflow, then deploy only that artifact through the authorized Netlify transport. Do not infer deployment from a GitHub merge alone.
evidence: Current Netlify deploy reports deploy_source=api and has_source_zip=true.
Current production commit_ref remains older than current GitHub main.
The Production Source Snapshot workflow packages git archive of exact GITHUB_SHA.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after exact-main source artifact, authorized Netlify production deploy, exact commit_ref readback, and provider readiness verification.
